_comment: Single source of truth for every dataset: where it comes from, license, expected checksum. fetch_datasets.py downloads + verifies from this; --docs regenerates SOURCE.md files and docs/DATASETS.md.

datasets.title: Crop Recommendation Dataset (Atharva Ingle)
datasets.role: PRIMARY - used by all training code
datasets.license: Kaggle page does not state a clear license (author says it was assembled from public India rainfall/climate/fertilizer data). A CC BY 4.0 copy exists on Figshare.
datasets.columns: N, P, K, temperature, humidity, ph, rainfall, label
datasets.notes: Kaggle's public download endpoint worked WITHOUT login (HTTP 200, 65 KB zip). Verified byte-identical to the Figshare CC BY 4.0 copy (https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Crop_Recommendation_dataset/26308696); a Hugging Face Space copy has identical values (only line endings differ). Clean, balanced, no nulls: published papers report ~98-99.6% accuracy.

datasets.title: Smart Crop Recommendation (Kaggle data + Cu, Fe, Mg, S)
datasets.role: optional extension (not used by code yet)
datasets.columns: Nitrogen(N), phosphorus (P), Potassium(K), Copper(cu), Iron(Fe), Magnesium(Mg), Sulpher(S), Temperature, Humidity, pH, Rainfall(cm), Crops
datasets.notes: Same N/P/K/temperature/humidity/pH/rainfall values as the primary set plus 4 extra micronutrient columns (11 features). Column header says rainfall in cm but the values equal the primary set's mm values - treat the unit label as unreliable.

datasets.title: CropRec-BD: crop recommendation for Bangladesh using IoT sensors
datasets.role: reference - real low-cost-sensor data, different features
datasets.columns: Soil (moisture fraction), Soil_Moisture, Humidity, Temperature, Crop Name
datasets.classes: 9 crops, 180-608 rows each (imbalanced); label has typos such as 'Sugercane'
datasets.notes: Only 4 sensor features (no NPK/pH/rain), so it cannot feed the 7-feature model. Useful to see how real sensor data differs: description is inconsistent about collection years (20XX-2025 vs 2017-2022) and the listing has no independent publication - treat as unvalidated.

datasets.title: Crop recommendation (crop requirement ranges: soil, season, N-P-K, water)
datasets.columns: CROPS, TYPE_OF_CROP, SOIL, SEASON, SOWN, HARVESTED, WATER_SOURCE, SOIL_PH, SOIL_PH_HIGH, CROPDURATION(+MAX), TEMP, MAX_TEMP, WATERREQUIRED(+MAX), RELATIVE_HUMIDITY(+MAX), N(+MAX), P(+MAX), K(+MAX)
datasets.classes: 57 crops x exactly 1000 rows (looks generated from per-crop min/max ranges)
datasets.notes: Per-crop requirement ranges rather than field measurements; exactly 1000 rows per class suggests synthetic expansion. Good for a 'does the recommended crop fit agronomic ranges' sanity check, not for accuracy claims.

datasets.title: Crop Recommendation using Soil Properties and Weather Prediction (Ethiopia)
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (NON-COMMERCIAL, NO DERIVATIVES - fine for coursework, do not redistribute modified copies)
datasets.columns: Soilcolor, Ph, K, P, N, Zn, S, seasonal humidity/temperature/precipitation (W/Sp/Su/Au), WD10M, GWETTOP, CLOUD_AMT, WS2M_RANGE, PS, label (29 columns)
datasets.notes: Satellite-weather (NASA POWER style) features + lab soil tests; a harder, realistic, imbalanced problem.

datasets.title: AgriNet: soil fertility for rice fertilizer recommendation (Bareilly, India)
datasets.role: reference - real lab soil tests, no label column
datasets.columns: Sample, pH, EC, OC, N, P, K, S, Zn, B, Fe, Mn, Cu, Area in Acre, Bigha
datasets.notes: Real KVK/IVRI laboratory soil-test certificates typed into a sheet. The scanned-certificate PDF (9.7 MB) is intentionally NOT downloaded. Shows real-world N/P/K magnitudes (N in 150-200 kg/ha range) which differ from the Kaggle set's scale.

datasets.title: Fertilizer Prediction (small)
datasets.role: optional stage-2 demo (not used by code yet)
datasets.columns: Temparature, Humidity (header has trailing space), Moisture, Soil Type, Crop Type, Nitrogen, Potassium, Phosphorous, Fertilizer Name
datasets.notes: Only 99 rows - a toy set; do not quote accuracy from it. Larger (~10k row) versions exist on Kaggle but need a Kaggle login.

datasets.title: India crop yield 1997-2020 (state level)
datasets.role: optional yield-regression add-on (not used by code yet)
datasets.columns: Crop, Crop_Year, Season, State, Area, Production, Annual_Rainfall, Fertilizer, Pesticide, Yield
datasets.classes: regression target Yield (55 crops, 27 states + 3 UTs); Season strings have trailing spaces
datasets.notes: Ramesh V and Kumaresan P, VIT University. Yield = Production / Area.

IEEE DataPort - Soil Fertility Data For Fertilizer Recommendation
Kaggle Fertilizer Prediction (~10k rows, mohitsingh14 upload)
